# Tarnside Model Railway Club: loco register

`locos.md` lists the club's running-day locos, one row each. Dates are written as year and month, like `2026-09`.

Every loco gets a service check. "Next check" is the month the next check is due: 12 months after "Last check".

`wall-chart.txt` is the chart that hangs in the club shed, typed up.
